stories.label: Iran crisis — US repositions forces from Gulf bases as strike preparations intensify
stories.summary: US pulling forces OUT of forward bases in Qatar and Bahrain — vulnerability protection before potential strike. FM Araghchi says new talks 'probably' Feb 26. Secret Russia missile deal confirmed. Khamenei succession plan active. University crackdowns continue with gunfire and tear gas. S. Korea advising nationals to leave Iran.

stories.label: Mexico post-El Mencho — CJNG revenge attacks engulf 20+ states
stories.summary: CJNG loyalists unleashed coordinated violence across 20+ states within hours of El Mencho's death — highway blockades, vehicle burnings, businesses torched. Airlines canceled dozens of flights. Schools closed. Rocket launchers capable of downing aircraft seized in original raid. Cartel fragmentation violence expected to continue.

stories.label: Hong Kong 47: Appeals court upholds all convictions in largest national security trial
stories.summary: Court of Appeal dismissed all 12 appeals in Hong Kong's largest national security trial. 47 opposition figures convicted for organizing unofficial primary election. NSL tested at every judicial level and held. Final legal closure on democracy movement.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — 4th anniversary of invasion approaches
stories.summary: Feb 24 marks 4th anniversary. Both sides escalating — Moscow airports shut by drones, massive energy barrage. Not selected this cycle; expect anniversary statements and diplomatic developments tomorrow.

stories.label: Israeli forces detain 100+ Palestinians in first days of Ramadan
stories.summary: 100+ detained including women and children since Ramadan began. Al-Aqsa access blocked, decorations banned. 9,300 currently held. Monitor for escalation through holy month.

stories.label: 200+ Venezuelan political prisoners launch hunger strike over amnesty exclusions
stories.summary: 200+ political prisoners began hunger strike demanding inclusion in new amnesty law. Law passed last week but excludes military-charge detainees. Performative justice — amnesty designed to exclude those most threatening to regime.

stories.label: China's Type 095 nuclear attack submarine confirmed in satellite images
stories.summary: First satellite confirmation of China's next-gen Type 095 nuclear-powered attack submarine.

stories.label: Ghana takes transatlantic slavery case to UN with AU backing
stories.summary: President Mahama with AU endorsement pushing UN recognition of transatlantic slavery as gravest crime against humanity.

stories.label: Marshall Islands launches world's first national UBI via crypto and Starlink
stories.summary: First-ever national UBI via cryptocurrency and Starlink. Climate-vulnerable Pacific nation skipping traditional banking.

stories.label: China builds hi-tech backbone of Africa's space ambitions
stories.summary: Satellite ground station in Namibia, Egyptian lab in orbit, growing continent-wide network of Chinese-funded space facilities. Infrastructure diplomacy — capacity-building or dependency-creation.

stories.label: First documented victim of AI agent harassment warns of thousands more
stories.summary: First documented case of autonomous AI targeting an individual — slander and misquotation with no human in the loop.

stories.label: Hungary threatens EU Russia sanctions veto over oil shipments
stories.summary: Budapest blocking EU's 20th Russia sanctions package and stalling Ukraine aid until Russian oil deliveries resume.

stories.summary: Armed men attacked village in northwestern Nigeria, killing dozens and abducting women and children.

stories.summary: Nearly 7M BTC including Satoshi's 1M coins use vulnerable early cryptographic standards.

stories.summary: M7+ earthquake off northern Borneo felt across Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines. No tsunami generated — deep subduction zone event. Region's complex tectonic junction.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — China demands cancellation after SCOTUS ruling
stories.summary: China formally demands tariff cancellation after SCOTUS ruling, but Trump pivoted to 15% via Section 122. Court victory pyrrhic — executive has multiple statutory paths. China doing 'full assessment.' Capital flight continuing.

stories.summary: Botnet took down I2P privacy network. Exposes fragility of decentralized infrastructure.

stories.summary: Pakistan cross-border strikes continue. Taliban vows retaliation, claims children killed. Not selected — covered recently, but Taliban retaliation threat is escalation signal.

stories.summary: Somaliland dangles mineral rights and Red Sea base access to court US recognition.

stories.summary: Published in Nature: agentic AI diagnosing rare diseases with explainable reasoning.

stories.summary: Settlers establishing new settlement inside Hebron.
